title: Concrete Driveway Installation
shortDescription: High-strength 32 MPa concrete driveways built for Ontario winters with steel reinforcement and deep gravel base.
fullDescription: Make a lasting impression with a driveway engineered for durability and long-term performance. We remove old surfaces and install a solid, steel-reinforced foundation designed to handle heavy loads and harsh Canadian weather. Our driveways are poured at 32 MPa strength with wire mesh or rebar throughout.
features: Steel wire mesh or rebar reinforcement

title: Stamped Concretes
shortDescription: Luxury look of slate, brick, or stone at a fraction of the cost. Custom patterns, colors, and sealed for durability.
fullDescription: Get the luxury look of slate, brick, or stone without the high maintenance of pavers. Our stamped concrete provides a seamless, weed-free surface that is custom-colored and professionally sealed to withstand the elements. Ideal for patios, pool decks, and entranceways that demand a premium finish.
features: Custom colors to match your home

title: Concrete Patio Installation
shortDescription: Durable, rot-free concrete patios for outdoor living. Curves, multi-level platforms, steps, and retaining walls.
fullDescription: Forget the hassle of maintaining a wood deck. Our custom concrete patios provide a durable, rot-free foundation for your outdoor living space. From simple pads for hot tubs to expansive stamped entertainment areas, we build patios that look great and last a lifetime.

title: Broom Finish Concrete
shortDescription: Industry-standard non-slip textured finish for driveways, sidewalks, and garage floors. Safe in rain and snow.
fullDescription: The perfect balance of function and affordability. Our broom-finished concrete provides a high-traction, non-slip surface essential for Canadian winters. Ideal for driveways, city sidewalks, and garage floors where safety and durability are the top priorities. Available in standard brush or decorative swirl patterns.
features: Available in standard or swirl pattern

title: Driveway Replacement
shortDescription: Complete removal of failing asphalt or concrete. Full demolition, disposal, regrading, and steel-reinforced installation.
fullDescription: Don't settle for temporary patches. We specialize in complete removal of failing asphalt and concrete driveways, including demolition, disposal, soil regrading, and steel-reinforced concrete installation. Increase your home's value with a driveway built to last 2–3x longer than asphalt.
